description: A table's PUBLIC page — the address its owner gives to people who have no account. Answers every switch of the page with its meaning, what a visitor can do there right now in plain words, and the addresses to hand out: the page's link, short link and embed code, and the same three for the public FORM that adds a record. Call it when the person asks for a link to share, an embed code for their site, or whether their data is open.
name: get_public_page
